{{Top|leg}}
The '''ruling families of Onderon''' were a group of [[Noble/Legends|ruling]] families from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. For several [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]], the ruling families exiled criminals and political dissidents from the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]], leaving them to be killed by beasts who migrated from the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]]. These dissidents formed the core of the [[Beast Riders]], a resistance movement that fought against the [[Onderonian/Legends|Onderonians]] in the [[Beast Wars]].<ref name="KOTORCG">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>
